latestVersion.changelog:
Video Editor for PC — Initial Release (v1.0.0)

- Launches an AI-powered video editor for PC, enabling quick edits and HD MP4 exports without installing traditional software.
- Supports upload of raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and natural-language instructions for editing tasks.
- Cloud-based GPU rendering with typical export times of 1-2 minutes for short clips; export available in multiple formats up to 1080p.
- Automatic first-time setup and user authentication using a free token system with 100 credits for 7 days.
- Provides clear workflows for uploading, editing, exporting, and checking credits or session status with concise user prompts.
- All video processing occurs server-side; clear error handling and guidance for unsupported files, large uploads, or credit issues.
